Question: Two circles lie outside regular hexagon \(ABCDEF.\) The first is tangent to \(\overline{AB},\) and the second is tangent to \(\overline{DE}.\) Both are tangent to lines \(BC\) and \(FA.\) What is the ratio of the area of the second circle to that of the first circle?
